author: Gordon Thelander
releaseNotes: 1.9.8 - the map page opens with a visible settle now instead of jumping straight from an unstyled knot to its final layout: shortly after the page's own first layout pass finishes, it runs the same Show all action a user would click by hand, which was already confirmed to animate visibly rather than snap. Also added: a Community Utilities button in the main button bar, linking to the companion Hubitat Community Utilities site (opens in a new tab, the map's own state is left alone). Cloudflare Web Analytics, added in 1.9.7, has been removed again at Gordon's request.
